body.objective: Make the resident-agent next-work path self-diagnosing when an agent reports an empty queue because it used the wrong stream name, already holds a lease, or the programme contains an invalid second live exclusive lease for the same agent.
body.stop_condition: Land a deterministic read-only `s-f agent status --agent A [--stream S] --now T` (or a documented equivalent) that prints every live/expired lease held by A, the exact resumable item and command, READY depth and next pull in the resolved stream, open requests addressed to that stream, and any programme-health defect. Make `s-f work ready --stream S` distinguish an unknown stream from a known empty stream and suggest close stream names such as `quantum-qme` for `quantum`. Make `work pull` and `work assign` refuse a second live exclusive lease for the same agent across different items with an actionable list of the existing lease and `work show/yield/abort/close` commands. Surface historical multiple-live-lease states as a health finding in overview rather than silently presenting both as ordinary work. Add deterministic fixtures for typo/alias suggestion, truly empty known stream, one active lease plus ready successors, stale/expired lease, two cross-item live leases, independent-reproduction exemption, and the current physics reproduction in which `quantum-qme-1` appears to have no work while two active leases and three ready items exist. Preserve explicit timestamps, append-only events and one-lease semantics.
body.current_gate: resident agent status and stream/lease diagnostics
body.forbid: no implicit lease release; no automatic stream alias that can route work without confirmation; no treating an expired lease as live; no hiding invalid historical overlap; no mutation from status/help commands; no weakening independent-reproduction typing; no special case for the quantum stream
activates: reliable resident self-service work resumption across all physics streams
body.resource_hint: SCIENCE FORGE CLI ROBUSTNESS. Reuse the folded agent-to-live-lease index requested by the cross-item CAS fix and the landed work-show/overview paths; do not introduce a second state fold.
notes: Live physics reproduction on 2026-07-21: the Quantum resident reported no work. The authoritative programme had stream `quantum-qme`, three READY items, and two simultaneous ACTIVE exclusive leases for `quantum-qme-1`; one active item also had uncommitted scientific artifacts. The current CLI makes these three causes look like an empty queue to the resident.

This request complements, rather than replaces, bug-science-forge-pull-transition-cas-race. The acquisition guard prevents new overlap; this status surface explains and safely repairs existing or historical overlap.
